services.name: Solana
services.access: Public RPC can be read without an account; production RPC capacity must be provisioned.
services.role: Read chain state, simulate transactions, and confirm user-signed transactions.
services.gate: A devnet transaction is simulated, approved in a real wallet, submitted, and confirmed; commitment, retries, and RPC limits are handled.

services.name: Helius
services.access: Create an account and provision an RPC endpoint or API key under the chosen plan.
services.role: Production RPC and indexed chain data for launch and market workflows.
services.gate: Authenticated RPC reads, quota handling, and independent health checks work; endpoint secrets stay on the server.

services.name: Phantom
services.access: A compatible wallet and explicit user connection/signing consent.
services.role: Wallet connection and user-approved Solana transaction signing.
services.gate: Real connect, rejection, disconnect, network mismatch, and signing flows pass on devnet.

services.name: Solflare
services.access: Use the official wallet integration documentation and user signing consent.
services.role: An additional Solana wallet option.
services.gate: Wallet detection, connection, cancellation, and devnet signing work on supported devices.

services.name: Backpack
services.access: Use the wallet provider integration and user connection/signing consent.
services.role: An additional wallet option for project creators.
services.gate: Provider availability, rejection, disconnect, and devnet transaction signing pass.

services.name: Meteora
services.access: Official SDKs are public; chain operations require RPC capacity, a wallet, and transaction fees.
services.role: Dynamic Bonding Curve launch configuration and a planned liquidity migration path.
services.gate: Devnet create/swap/migrate tests pass with validated parameters and explicit signing; fee and migration behavior are documented.

services.name: Jupiter
services.access: Create a developer-platform key and confirm the API family, plan, and quotas.
services.role: Price discovery and a reviewed swap-routing integration.
services.gate: Quotes are fresh, token mints verified, slippage bounded, and signed execution confirmed on chain.

services.name: Raydium
services.access: Review official SDK/program references; transactions require wallet signing and RPC.
services.role: Alternative launch and liquidity research; route selection remains a design decision.
services.gate: One explicit launch route is chosen; program/configuration and fee behavior are verified in integration tests.

services.name: Birdeye
services.access: Confirm endpoint access and API-key requirements with the developer portal; several deep documentation links were unavailable during this review.
services.role: Token market data and freshness checks for discovery.
services.gate: Authorized reads, timestamp validation, rate limits, and unavailable-data UI work.

services.name: Paymenter
services.access: Deploy your own Paymenter portal; API reference requires v1.2.0+ and a server-side bearer token.
services.role: Orders, invoices, and service state for paid developer workspaces.
services.gate: Checkout, paid-order reconciliation, provisioning, suspension, and user ownership checks pass before terminal access is enabled.

services.name: OpenAI
services.access: Create project access and store an API credential on the backend with usage controls.
services.role: A planned Responses/Realtime gateway for project assistants.
services.gate: Server-side authentication, budgets, streaming errors, cancellation, and tenant boundaries are tested.

services.name: Claude
services.access: Provision Anthropic API access and keep credentials on the backend.
services.role: A planned Claude model gateway.
services.gate: Authenticated requests, quota handling, streaming interruption, and tenant metering pass.

services.name: Gemini
services.access: Create the appropriate project/API key and review available quotas.
services.role: A planned Gemini model gateway.
services.gate: Server-side access, supported models, quota handling, and tenant metering pass.

services.name: Grok / xAI
services.access: Provision xAI API access; it is separate from X social developer credentials.
services.role: A planned Grok model gateway.
services.gate: Authorized server-side calls, streaming failure handling, and budget controls pass.

services.name: X social API
services.access: Approved developer app and an access plan; OAuth mode and scopes depend on the endpoint.
services.role: User-authorized community publishing and project updates.
services.gate: PKCE/user authorization, required scopes, revocation, quotas, and explicit publish consent work.

services.name: X Money / payments
services.access: Public merchant API access has not been established from official documentation reviewed.
services.role: Conditional future payment rail; not enabled and not interchangeable with independent xMoney products.
services.gate: Obtain official merchant eligibility and API documentation first; then review settlement, refunds, and reconciliation.

services.name: GitHub
services.access: GitHub CLI is already authorized for this project archive; an in-product integration needs its own authorization.
services.role: Source archive today; planned repository evidence and developer workflow connections.
services.gate: App/user scopes, project ownership, private repository access, and webhook signature checks are implemented.

services.name: Cloudflare
services.access: Account, domain and an owner-configured Tunnel/Access policy; credentials remain on the machine or backend.
services.role: Planned DNS, protected tunnels, edge delivery and storage options for developer projects.
services.gate: Verify domain ownership, access policy, tunnel health and revocation before attaching a project.

services.name: Docker
services.access: An owner-managed Linux machine and a supported container engine installation.
services.role: Planned isolated app containers on a personal PC, Raspberry Pi or managed server.
services.gate: Review image architecture, resource limits, non-root permissions, persistent data and restart behavior.

services.name: Tailscale
services.access: An owner-controlled tailnet, enrolled devices and reviewed access policies.
services.role: Planned private network access to a developer-owned machine.
services.gate: Verify device ownership, least-privilege policy, service reachability and device removal.

services.name: Raspberry Pi
services.access: A developer-owned Raspberry Pi, compatible OS, storage and network connection.
services.role: Planned lightweight ARM workspace on your own hardware.
services.gate: Verify OS/ARM compatibility, resources, explicit enrollment and device heartbeat; a brand status page cannot establish your hardware uptime.

services.name: Supabase
services.access: A project with reviewed authentication, database policies and server-side credentials.
services.role: Planned project identity, database, storage and application data.
services.gate: Test row-level policies, tenant boundaries, backups and key handling before storing project data.

services.name: Vercel
services.access: An authorized project, repository connection and reviewed build configuration.
services.role: Planned app deployment with project previews and build evidence.
services.gate: Check repository ownership, build results, environment separation and rollback.

services.name: Netlify
services.access: An authorized site, repository connection and reviewed deployment settings.
services.role: Planned website delivery and deployment previews.
services.gate: Check repository ownership, deployment evidence, environment settings and rollback.

services.name: PostgreSQL
services.access: An owner-managed database with a restricted application role and tested backups.
services.role: Planned durable project data on managed or developer-owned infrastructure.
services.gate: Test access isolation, migrations, backups and recovery; local database health needs an owner-specific probe.

phases.title: Foundation & visibility
phases.description: The website is published with a working local project library, portable backups and milestone tracking. Read-only Solana pool search uses public market data. Official provider status feeds can be checked directly from the public site; backend connections remain unconfigured.
gates: Deploy the monitor beside the website with HTTPS.
Add an independent external uptime probe and alert owner.
Protect the internal health feed and document an incident procedure.

phases.title: Identity, wallets & chain
phases.description: Replace demo wallet state with real authorization and devnet transactions.
gates: Implement account ownership and session security.
Connect real wallet adapters and an authenticated production RPC.
Test rejected signatures, network mismatch, confirmation, and RPC limits.

phases.title: Launch & liquidity
phases.description: Build one validated launch route with observable chain receipts and reliable market data.
gates: Choose Meteora DBC or an explicitly reviewed alternative route.
Resolve SDK dependency advisories; validate launch parameters and fee/migration behavior on devnet.
Handle stale quotes, transaction failure, and indexer delays.

phases.title: Hosting & your own hardware
phases.description: Choose a managed Paymenter workspace or plan a connection to your own Linux PC / Raspberry Pi. Local plans work today; machine enrollment and remote execution are future work.
gates: Connect Paymenter checkout and service ownership for the managed path.
Build explicit machine enrollment, identity, revocation and an outbound authenticated bridge for the own-hardware path.
Verify architecture, access policies, heartbeat and isolated workloads before enabling terminal access.

phases.title: AI service gateways
phases.description: Add model providers through a metered backend with project-level budgets.
gates: Provision provider project access and protected server credentials.
Test quota, streaming cancellation, and request attribution.
Expose per-connector health without prompts, tokens, or customer data.

phases.title: Community & X
phases.description: Enable scoped, user-approved community actions after X app access is confirmed.
gates: Confirm the developer plan, endpoints, and scopes.
Implement user OAuth, revocation, and explicit publish consent.
Show permission/quota failures as connector issues rather than platform outages.

phases.title: X payment rail
phases.description: A conditional research track until official X merchant API access is available.
gates: Obtain official merchant eligibility and API reference from X.
Define settlement, refund, dispute, and reconciliation requirements.
Validate the authorized payment integration before enabling checkout.
